name: health
title: Health component
summary: A Node holding hit points: damage/heal with an invulnerability window, died/revived signals, ratio() for bars, set_max for level-ups. Never frees its parent.
usage: Add a Node named Health with scripts/health.gd under anything that can be hurt. Attackers call `$Health.damage(3, self)`. Connect `died` in the parent and decide what death means there; connect `health_changed` to a bar and read `ratio()`.
